source.upstream: Ken French data library, archived by linearmodels; not independently reconciled to today's revised upstream release
source.units: Monthly decimal portfolio returns; 0.01 means 1%, not 0.01%
source.adjustments: Research portfolio returns compounded into total-return levels; not adjusted executable prices. Dividend/corporate-action processing inherited from the archive, not independently reconstructed.
source.rights: Third-party data rights not inferred from code licence; raw archive stays local.

audit.checks: Contiguous unique months, all columns, finite decimal returns, missing-code rejection, checksum, full evaluation coverage

design: Fixed 12-month lookback, one-month execution delay and 10bps cost. No parameter selection. All other settings are descriptive sensitivity, not independent holdouts. Equal initial capital in 12 independent sleeves; no cross-sleeve rebalancing.

uncertainty.estimand: annualised arithmetic mean strategy-minus-buy-and-hold daily return; not CAGR
